class SourceLine(int number, string[] words)
class Config()
    floors := 0
    count := 0
    capacity := 0
    door := 0
    int[] starts := []
    int[] lows := []
    int[] highs := []
    int[] homes := []
    policy := 0
    park := -1
    patience := -1
    bypass := 100
    period := -1
    limit := 1000
    int[] compare := []
class Event(int clock, int command, a := 0, b := 0, c := 0)
class Validation()
    Event[] events := []
    string[] errors := []
class Group(int clock, int landing, int destination, int count)
    waiting := count
    car := -1
    boarded := 0
    delivered := 0
    lost := 0
    last_board := 0
    last_alight := 0
    cars := array(8, fill = false)
    wait_total := 0
    travel_total := 0
class Passenger(int group, int count, int clock)
class Car(int floor)
    direction := 0
    door := 0
    service := true
    idle_start := 0
    int[] calls := []
    Passenger[] passengers := []
    distance := 0
    stops := 0
    boarded := 0
    busy := 0
    energy := 0
class Simulation(Config config, int policy, bool logging)
    Group[] groups := []
    Car[] cars := []
    int[] pending := []
    fire := 0
    last_round := 0
    clock := 0
    aborted := false
    delivered := 0
    abandoned := 0
    evacuated := 0
    wait_total := 0
    travel_total := 0
    max_wait := 0
    string[] log := []
class Result(string name)
    valid := false
    aborted := false
    policy := 0
    delivered := 0
    wait_total := 0
    travel_total := 0
    max_wait := 0
string[] policies()
    return "COST NEAREST ROUND ETA".split(" ")
string[] keys()
    return "FLOORS CARS CAPACITY DOOR START POLICY ZONES PARK PATIENCE BYPASS PERIOD LIMIT COMPARE".split(" ")
string[] commands()
    return "CALL CANCEL OUT IN HOLD FIRE RESET WHERE STATUS".split(" ")
int lookup(const string[] names, string text)
    for: index < #names
        if names[index] == text
            return int(index)
    return -1
bool bounded(int value, int low, int high)
    return low <= value <= high
int sign(int value)
    return if value > 0 then 1 elif value < 0 then -1 else 0
int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value
int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b
int maximum(int a, int b)
    return if a > b then a else b
string average(int total, int count)
    if count == 0
        return "-"
    value := total * 100 / count
    fraction := value % 100
    return "{value / 100}." + (if fraction < 10 then "0" else "") + string(fraction)
string optional(int value, missing := "off")
    return if value < 0 then missing else string(value)
string joined(const string[] words)
    return if #words == 0 then "-" else words.join(",")
int[] remove(const int[] values, int value)
    return [for item := values[] if item != value then item]
bool serves(const Config config, int car, int a, int b)
    return bounded(a, config.lows[car], config.highs[car]) and bounded(b, config.lows[car], config.highs[car])
Config | error configuration(const SourceLine[] lines)
    names := keys()
    seen := array(13, fill = false)
    string[][] values := array(13, fill = [""])
    for line := lines[]
        key := lookup(names, line.words[0])
        if key < 0
            return error("unknown key {line.words[0]}")
        if seen[key]
            return error("duplicate key {line.words[0]}")
        seen[key] = true
        values[key] = line.words[1:]
    for: key < 5
        if not seen[key]
            return error("missing key {names[key]}")
    config := Config()
    for: key < 13
        if not seen[key]
            continue
        words := values[key]
        count := int(#words)
        valid_count := if key == 4 or key == 6 then count == config.count elif key == 7 then count == config.count + 1 elif key == 12 then bounded(count, 1, 4) else count == 1
        if not valid_count
            return error("wrong number of values for {names[key]}")
        valid := true
        if key <= 3
            value := int(words[0])
            lower := [2, 1, 1, 1]
            upper := [50, 8, 20, 9]
            valid = bounded(value, lower[key], upper[key])
            if key == 0
                config.floors = value
            elif key == 1
                config.count = value
            elif key == 2
                config.capacity = value
            else
                config.door = value
        elif key == 4
            for word := words[]
                value := int(word)
                valid = valid and bounded(value, 1, config.floors)
                config.starts = config.starts.append(value)
        elif key == 5
            config.policy = lookup(policies(), words[0])
            valid = config.policy >= 0
        elif key == 6
            for word := words[]
                parts := word.split(":")
                low := int(parts[0])
                high := int(parts[1])
                valid = valid and 1 <= low < high <= config.floors
                config.lows = config.lows.append(low)
                config.highs = config.highs.append(high)
        elif key == 7
            config.park = int(words[0])
            valid = bounded(config.park, 0, 100)
            for word := words[1:][]
                value := int(word)
                valid = valid and bounded(value, 1, config.floors)
                config.homes = config.homes.append(value)
        elif key < 12
            value := int(words[0])
            if key == 8
                config.patience = value
                valid = bounded(value, 1, 1000)
            elif key == 9
                config.bypass = value
                valid = bounded(value, 50, 100)
            elif key == 10
                config.period = value
                valid = bounded(value, 1, 1000)
            else
                config.limit = value
                valid = bounded(value, 1, 5000)
        else
            for word := words[]
                policy := lookup(policies(), word)
                if policy < 0
                    valid = false
                for previous := config.compare[]
                    if previous == policy
                        valid = false
                config.compare = config.compare.append(policy)
        if not valid
            return error("bad value for {names[key]}")
    if not seen[6]
        config.lows = array(nat(config.count), fill = 1)
        config.highs = array(nat(config.count), fill = config.floors)
    for: car < config.count
        if not bounded(config.starts[car], config.lows[car], config.highs[car])
            return error("car {car + 1} starts outside its zone")
        if config.park >= 0 and not bounded(config.homes[car], config.lows[car], config.highs[car])
            return error("car {car + 1} home outside its zone")
    return config
string event_problem(const Config config, const SourceLine source, int last_time, int group_count, bool fire, const bool[] out)
    words := source.words
    command := lookup(commands(), words[1])
    if command < 0
        return "unknown command {words[1]}"
    counts := [3, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 0, 1, 0]
    if int(#words) - 2 != counts[command]
        return "wrong number of arguments for {words[1]}"
    if int(words[0]) < last_time
        return "time goes backwards"
    int[] arguments := [for word := words[2:][] then int(word)]
    a := if #arguments > 0 then arguments[0] else 0
    b := if #arguments > 1 then arguments[1] else 0
    if command == 0
        if not bounded(a, 1, config.floors) or not bounded(b, 1, config.floors)
            return "bad floor"
        if a == b
            return "same floor"
        if not bounded(arguments[2], 1, 99)
            return "bad count"
        served := false
        for: car < config.count
            served = served or serves(config, car, a, b)
        if not served
            return "no car serves {a}->{b}"
        if fire
            return "fire service active"
    elif command == 1 or command == 7
        if not bounded(a, 1, group_count)
            return "unknown group"
    elif command == 2 or command == 3
        if not bounded(a, 1, config.count)
            return "bad car"
        if out[a - 1] == (command == 2)
            return "car {a} already " + (if command == 2 then "out" else "in")
    elif command == 4
        if not bounded(a, 1, config.count)
            return "bad car"
        if not bounded(b, 1, 9)
            return "bad ticks"
    elif command == 5
        if not bounded(a, 1, config.floors)
            return "bad floor"
        if fire
            return "fire already active"
    elif command == 6 and not fire
        return "fire not active"
    return ""
Validation validate_events(const Config config, const SourceLine[] lines)
    validation := Validation()
    last_time := 0
    group_count := 0
    fire := false
    out := array(nat(config.count), fill = false)
    for source := lines[]
        problem := event_problem(config, source, last_time, group_count, fire, out)
        if problem != ""
            validation.errors = validation.errors.append("line {source.number}: {problem}")
            continue
        words := source.words
        clock := int(words[0])
        command := lookup(commands(), words[1])
        int a := if #words > 2 then int(words[2]) else 0
        int b := if #words > 3 then int(words[3]) else 0
        int c := if #words > 4 then int(words[4]) else 0
        last_time = clock
        if command == 0
            group_count += 1
        elif command == 2 or command == 3
            out[a - 1] = command == 2
        elif command == 5 or command == 6
            fire = command == 5
        validation.events = validation.events.append(Event(clock, command, a, b, c))
    return validation
void emit(Simulation &simulation, string text)
    if simulation.logging
        simulation.log = simulation.log.append("{simulation.clock} " + text)
int load(const Car car)
    total := 0
    for passenger := car.passengers[]
        total += passenger.count
    return total
bool[] targets(const Simulation simulation, int index)
    floors := array(51, fill = false)
    car := simulation.cars[index]
    for passenger := car.passengers[]
        floors[simulation.groups[passenger.group].destination] = true
    for group := car.calls[]
        floors[simulation.groups[group].landing] = true
    return floors
bool bypassing(const Simulation simulation, int index)
    return load(simulation.cars[index]) * 100 >= simulation.config.capacity * simulation.config.bypass
int cost(const Simulation simulation, int index, int group_index)
    car := simulation.cars[index]
    group := simulation.groups[group_index]
    floor := car.floor
    direction := car.direction
    landing := group.landing
    if simulation.policy == 1 or direction == 0
        return absolute(floor - landing)
    floors := targets(simulation, index)
    distance := 0
    via := 0
    if sign(group.destination - landing) == direction and (landing - floor) * direction >= 0
        distance = absolute(landing - floor)
        for: 1 <= target <= simulation.config.floors
            if floors[target] and (target - floor) * direction > 0 and (landing - target) * direction > 0
                via += 1
    else
        turn := floor
        for: 1 <= target <= simulation.config.floors
            if floors[target]
                if (target - turn) * direction > 0
                    turn = target
                if (target - floor) * direction > 0
                    via += 1
        distance = absolute(floor - turn) + absolute(turn - landing)
    return if simulation.policy == 3 then distance + simulation.config.door * via + car.door else distance
bool assign(Simulation &simulation, int group_index, excluded := -1)
    group := simulation.groups[group_index]
    selected := -1
    best_cost := 0
    for: index < simulation.config.count
        if index == excluded or not simulation.cars[index].service or not serves(simulation.config, index, group.landing, group.destination)
            continue
        if simulation.policy == 2
            if selected < 0
                selected = index
            if index + 1 > simulation.last_round
                selected = index
                break
        else
            candidate := cost(simulation, index, group_index)
            if selected < 0 or candidate < best_cost
                selected = index
                best_cost = candidate
    if selected < 0
        return false
    if simulation.policy == 2
        simulation.last_round = selected + 1
        emit(&simulation, "E{selected + 1} ASSIGN G{group_index + 1}")
    else
        emit(&simulation, "E{selected + 1} ASSIGN G{group_index + 1} cost={best_cost}")
    if group.car >= 0
        simulation.cars[group.car].calls = remove(simulation.cars[group.car].calls, group_index)
    simulation.cars[selected].calls = simulation.cars[selected].calls.append(group_index)
    simulation.groups[group_index].car = selected
    return true
void dispatch(Simulation &simulation, int group)
    if not assign(&simulation, group)
        simulation.pending = simulation.pending.append(group)
        emit(&simulation, "PENDING G{group + 1}")
void walk(Simulation &simulation, int index, string word)
    group := simulation.groups[index]
    if group.car >= 0
        simulation.cars[group.car].calls = remove(simulation.cars[group.car].calls, index)
    else
        simulation.pending = remove(simulation.pending, index)
    simulation.groups[index].car = -1
    emit(&simulation, "{word} G{index + 1} x{group.waiting}")
    simulation.abandoned += group.waiting
    simulation.groups[index].lost += group.waiting
    simulation.groups[index].waiting = 0
string group_list(const int[] groups)
    return joined([for group := groups[] then "G{group + 1}"])
void perform(Simulation &simulation, const Event event)
    a := event.a
    b := event.b
    if event.command == 0
        index := int(#simulation.groups)
        simulation.groups = simulation.groups.append(Group(simulation.clock, a, b, event.c))
        emit(&simulation, "CALL G{index + 1} {a}->{b} x{event.c}")
        dispatch(&simulation, index)
    elif event.command == 1
        if simulation.groups[a - 1].waiting > 0
            walk(&simulation, a - 1, "CANCEL")
        else
            emit(&simulation, "CANCEL G{a} ignored")
    elif event.command == 2
        simulation.cars[a - 1].service = false
        emit(&simulation, "E{a} OUT")
        calls := simulation.cars[a - 1].calls
        simulation.cars[a - 1].calls = []
        for index := calls[]
            simulation.groups[index].car = -1
            dispatch(&simulation, index)
    elif event.command == 3
        simulation.cars[a - 1].service = true
        simulation.cars[a - 1].idle_start = simulation.clock
        emit(&simulation, "E{a} IN")
        pending := simulation.pending
        simulation.pending = []
        for index := pending[]
            if not assign(&simulation, index)
                simulation.pending = simulation.pending.append(index)
    elif event.command == 4
        if simulation.cars[a - 1].door > 0
            simulation.cars[a - 1].door += b
            emit(&simulation, "E{a} HOLD {simulation.cars[a - 1].door}")
        else
            emit(&simulation, "E{a} HOLD ignored")
    elif event.command == 5
        simulation.fire = a
        emit(&simulation, "FIRE {a}")
        for: index < #simulation.groups
            if simulation.groups[index].waiting > 0
                walk(&simulation, int(index), "ABANDON")
    elif event.command == 6
        simulation.fire = 0
        emit(&simulation, "RESET")
        for: index < simulation.config.count
            simulation.cars[index].idle_start = simulation.clock
    elif event.command == 7
        group := simulation.groups[a - 1]
        place := if group.waiting == 0 then "-" elif group.car < 0 then "pending" else "E{group.car + 1}"
        string[] riding := []
        for: index < simulation.config.count
            people := 0
            for passenger := simulation.cars[index].passengers[]
                if passenger.group == a - 1
                    people += passenger.count
            if people > 0
                riding = riding.append("E{index + 1}x{people}")
        emit(&simulation, "WHERE G{a} waiting={group.waiting} car={place} riding={joined(riding)} delivered={group.delivered} lost={group.lost}")
    else
        for: index < simulation.config.count
            car := simulation.cars[index]
            floors := array(51, fill = false)
            for passenger := car.passengers[]
                floors[simulation.groups[passenger.group].destination] = true
            string[] stops := []
            for: 1 <= floor <= simulation.config.floors
                if floors[floor]
                    stops = stops.append(string(floor))
            direction := if car.direction > 0 then "up" elif car.direction < 0 then "down" else "idle"
            emit(&simulation, "STATUS E{index + 1} floor={car.floor} dir={direction} door={car.door} load={load(car)} stops={joined(stops)} calls={group_list(car.calls)} service=" + (if car.service then "in" else "out"))
        emit(&simulation, "STATUS pending=" + group_list(simulation.pending))
int direction(const Simulation simulation, int index)
    car := simulation.cars[index]
    floor := car.floor
    heading := car.direction
    floors := targets(simulation, index)
    ahead := false
    behind := false
    for: 1 <= target <= simulation.config.floors
        if floors[target]
            ahead = ahead or (target - floor) * heading > 0
            behind = behind or (target - floor) * heading < 0
    first := -1
    same := false
    if not bypassing(simulation, index)
        for group_index := car.calls[]
            group := simulation.groups[group_index]
            if group.landing == floor
                if first < 0
                    first = group_index
                same = same or sign(group.destination - group.landing) == heading
    if heading != 0 and (ahead or same)
        return heading
    if first >= 0
        return sign(simulation.groups[first].destination - floor)
    if heading != 0 and behind
        return -heading
    if heading == 0 and #car.calls > 0
        return sign(simulation.groups[car.calls[0]].landing - floor)
    return 0
void move(Simulation &simulation, int index, int step)
    simulation.cars[index].energy += if step > 0 then 3 + load(simulation.cars[index]) else 1
    simulation.cars[index].distance += 1
    simulation.cars[index].floor += step
void open_doors(Simulation &simulation, int index)
    floor := simulation.cars[index].floor
    emit(&simulation, "E{index + 1} OPEN {floor}")
    simulation.cars[index].door = simulation.config.door
    simulation.cars[index].stops += 1
    simulation.cars[index].energy += 2
    Passenger[] riding := []
    for passenger := simulation.cars[index].passengers[]
        group_index := passenger.group
        group := simulation.groups[group_index]
        if group.destination == floor
            emit(&simulation, "E{index + 1} ALIGHT G{group_index + 1} x{passenger.count}")
            wait := passenger.clock - group.clock
            travel := simulation.clock - group.clock
            simulation.groups[group_index].delivered += passenger.count
            simulation.groups[group_index].last_alight = simulation.clock
            simulation.groups[group_index].wait_total += wait * passenger.count
            simulation.groups[group_index].travel_total += travel * passenger.count
            simulation.delivered += passenger.count
            simulation.wait_total += wait * passenger.count
            simulation.travel_total += travel * passenger.count
            simulation.max_wait = maximum(simulation.max_wait, wait)
        elif simulation.fire > 0
            emit(&simulation, "E{index + 1} EVACUATE G{group_index + 1} x{passenger.count}")
            simulation.groups[group_index].lost += passenger.count
            simulation.evacuated += passenger.count
        else
            riding = riding.append(passenger)
    simulation.cars[index].passengers = riding
    if simulation.fire > 0
        return
    heading := direction(simulation, index)
    if heading != 0
        simulation.cars[index].direction = heading
    int[] boarding := []
    for group_index := simulation.cars[index].calls[]
        group := simulation.groups[group_index]
        if group.landing == floor and sign(group.destination - group.landing) == heading
            boarding = boarding.append(group_index)
    for group_index := boarding[]
        people := minimum(simulation.config.capacity - load(simulation.cars[index]), simulation.groups[group_index].waiting)
        if people > 0
            simulation.cars[index].passengers = simulation.cars[index].passengers.append(Passenger(group_index, people, simulation.clock))
            simulation.cars[index].boarded += people
            simulation.groups[group_index].waiting -= people
            simulation.groups[group_index].boarded += people
            simulation.groups[group_index].last_board = simulation.clock
            simulation.groups[group_index].cars[index] = true
            emit(&simulation, "E{index + 1} BOARD G{group_index + 1} x{people}")
        if simulation.groups[group_index].waiting == 0
            simulation.cars[index].calls = remove(simulation.cars[index].calls, group_index)
            simulation.groups[group_index].car = -1
        else
            emit(&simulation, "E{index + 1} LEFT G{group_index + 1} x{simulation.groups[group_index].waiting}")
            assigned := assign(&simulation, group_index, index)
void advance(Simulation &simulation, int index)
    old_floor := simulation.cars[index].floor
    if simulation.cars[index].door > 0
        simulation.cars[index].door -= 1
    if simulation.cars[index].door == 0
        car := simulation.cars[index]
        heading := if simulation.fire > 0 then sign(simulation.fire - car.floor) else direction(simulation, index)
        stop := simulation.fire > 0 and heading == 0 and #car.passengers > 0
        if simulation.fire == 0
            for passenger := car.passengers[]
                stop = stop or simulation.groups[passenger.group].destination == car.floor
            if not bypassing(simulation, index)
                for group_index := car.calls[]
                    group := simulation.groups[group_index]
                    stop = stop or (group.landing == car.floor and sign(group.destination - group.landing) == heading)
        if stop
            open_doors(&simulation, index)
        elif heading != 0
            simulation.cars[index].direction = heading
            move(&simulation, index, heading)
        else
            if car.direction != 0
                emit(&simulation, "E{index + 1} IDLE {car.floor}")
                simulation.cars[index].direction = 0
                simulation.cars[index].idle_start = simulation.clock
            if simulation.fire == 0 and car.service and simulation.config.park >= 0 and car.floor != simulation.config.homes[index] and simulation.clock - simulation.cars[index].idle_start >= simulation.config.park
                move(&simulation, index, sign(simulation.config.homes[index] - car.floor))
                if simulation.cars[index].floor == simulation.config.homes[index]
                    emit(&simulation, "E{index + 1} PARK {simulation.config.homes[index]}")
    if simulation.cars[index].door > 0 or simulation.cars[index].floor != old_floor
        simulation.cars[index].busy += 1
bool settled(const Simulation simulation, int index)
    car := simulation.cars[index]
    if car.door > 0 or #car.passengers > 0 or #car.calls > 0
        return false
    if simulation.fire > 0
        return car.floor == simulation.fire
    return not car.service or simulation.config.park < 0 or car.floor == simulation.config.homes[index]
Simulation simulate(const Config config, const Event[] events, int policy, bool logging)
    simulation := Simulation(config, policy, logging)
    for floor := config.starts[]
        simulation.cars = simulation.cars.append(Car(floor))
    next := 0
    while true
        if config.patience >= 0
            for: index < #simulation.groups
                group := simulation.groups[index]
                if group.waiting > 0 and simulation.clock == group.clock + config.patience
                    walk(&simulation, int(index), "ABANDON")
        while next < int(#events) and events[next].clock == simulation.clock
            perform(&simulation, events[next])
            next += 1
        for: index < config.count
            advance(&simulation, index)
        all := true
        for: index < config.count
            all = all and settled(simulation, index)
        if next == int(#events) and all
            emit(&simulation, "END")
            break
        if simulation.clock == config.limit
            simulation.aborted = true
            emit(&simulation, "ABORT")
            break
        simulation.clock += 1
    return simulation
string averages(int delivered, int wait_total, int travel_total, int max_wait)
    return "avg_wait={average(wait_total, delivered)} avg_travel={average(travel_total, delivered)} max_wait=" + (if delivered == 0 then "-" else string(max_wait))
string breakdown(const Simulation simulation, int key, bool period)
    groups := 0
    passengers := 0
    delivered := 0
    wait := 0
    for group := simulation.groups[]
        if (if period then group.clock / simulation.config.period else group.landing) == key
            groups += 1
            passengers += group.count
            delivered += group.delivered
            wait += group.wait_total
    if groups == 0
        return ""
    label := if period then "P{key} {key * simulation.config.period}-{key * simulation.config.period + simulation.config.period - 1}" else "F{key}"
    return label + ": groups={groups} passengers={passengers} delivered={delivered} avg_wait={average(wait, delivered)}"
string[] report(const Simulation simulation)
    string[] result := []
    passengers := 0
    for: index < #simulation.groups
        group := simulation.groups[index]
        wait := if group.boarded == group.count then string(group.last_board - group.clock) else "-"
        travel := if group.delivered == group.count then string(group.last_alight - group.clock) else "-"
        string[] cars := []
        for: car < simulation.config.count
            if group.cars[car]
                cars = cars.append(string(car + 1))
        result = result.append("G{index + 1} t={group.clock} {group.landing}->{group.destination} n={group.count} delivered={group.delivered} lost={group.lost} wait={wait} travel={travel} cars={joined(cars)}")
        passengers += group.count
    for: index < simulation.config.count
        car := simulation.cars[index]
        utilization := car.busy * 1000 / (simulation.clock + 1)
        result = result.append("E{index + 1} distance={car.distance} stops={car.stops} boarded={car.boarded} busy={car.busy} util={utilization / 10}.{utilization % 10}% energy={car.energy}")
    for: 1 <= floor <= simulation.config.floors
        line := breakdown(simulation, floor, false)
        if line != ""
            result = result.append(line)
    if simulation.config.period >= 0
        for: period <= 10000 / simulation.config.period
            line := breakdown(simulation, period, true)
            if line != ""
                result = result.append(line)
    return result.append("summary: groups={#simulation.groups} passengers={passengers} delivered={simulation.delivered} abandoned={simulation.abandoned} evacuated={simulation.evacuated} " + averages(simulation.delivered, simulation.wait_total, simulation.travel_total, simulation.max_wait) + " end={simulation.clock}")
string[] config_lines(const Config config)
    names := policies()
    compare := joined([for policy := config.compare[] then names[policy]])
    result := ["config: floors={config.floors} cars={config.count} capacity={config.capacity} door={config.door} policy={names[config.policy]} park={optional(config.park)} patience={optional(config.patience)} bypass={config.bypass} period={optional(config.period)} limit={config.limit} compare={compare}"]
    for: index < config.count
        home := if config.park < 0 then "-" else string(config.homes[index])
        result = result.append("E{index + 1}: start={config.starts[index]} zone={config.lows[index]}-{config.highs[index]} home={home}")
    return result
bool before(const Result a, const Result b)
    left := a.wait_total * b.delivered
    right := b.wait_total * a.delivered
    return if left != right then left < right else a.travel_total * b.delivered < b.travel_total * a.delivered
